objects: cream map with blue rivers, tan roads and ring road
actions: blue river lines lengthen and tan ring road and radial roads draw in across 8.0 to 8.8 s
Texas card fades out by 8.2 s
observed: Frames 8.0 to 8.8 s. The same table scene. The map gains a long blue river winding down the centre, a second thinner river, a tan oval loop road and crossing roads, drawn progressively. The Texas card fades and is gone from 8.2 s onward. Caption The service began in February. The bottom third is empty table planks.
